title: Pedestrian access leg minimum width 1.5 m
text: Where a pedestrian access leg is required to provide access from a dwelling site to a public street, it is to: i. be a minimum width of 1.5m; and ii. provide a continuous path of travel with a minimum width of 1m, clear of any utilities or minor projections (excluding eaves). The pedestrian access leg may be reduced to 1m where required to retain an existing dwelling.

exceptions.label: reduced to 1 m where required to retain an existing dwelling

replaces.note: Part C C3.7.10-C3.7.12; new deemed exempt for R40 and below (Part B relied on subdivision policy)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Condition uses the proposed fact site.has_pedestrian_access_leg (a pedestrian-only leg is distinct from a battleaxe leg). 'Where required to retain' is tested only as the dwelling being retained.
